import pickle,json,subprocess
base=pickle.load(open('/tmp/base.pkl','rb'))
def run(args,inp=b'\n'):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','/work/batch.py',*args],input=inp,capture_output=True,timeout=10)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
def strip(r): r=dict(r); r.pop('elapsed_ms'); return r
ok=True
for k,(bc,bo,be) in base.items():
    for rep in range(2):
        c,o,e=run([] if k=='__default' else [k])
        old=[json.loads(l) for l in be.decode().splitlines()]
        new=[json.loads(l) for l in e.decode().splitlines()]
        checks={
         'exit':c==bc,'stdout':o==bo,'count':len(old)==len(new),
         'seq':[r.get('sequence') for r in new]==list(range(len(new))),
         'seqint':all(type(r['sequence']) is int for r in new),
         'fields':all(strip({kk:v for kk,v in n.items() if kk!='sequence'})==strip(ol) for n,ol in zip(new,old)),
         'keyorder':all(list(n)[:-1]==list(ol) and list(n)[-1]=='sequence' for n,ol in zip(new,old)),
         'elapsed_int':all(type(n['elapsed_ms']) is int for n in new),
        }
        bad=[x for x,v in checks.items() if not v]; ok&=not bad
        if rep==0: print(k,c,[r['event'] for r in new],[r['sequence'] for r in new],'FAIL '+str(bad) if bad else 'ok')
c,o,e=run(['bogus']);print('bogus',c,e.splitlines()[-1]);ok&=c==1
c,o,e=run(['live'],b'');print('live-no-input',c,e.decode().splitlines()[-1][-60:])
c0,_,e0=subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/batch.orig.py','live'],input=b'',capture_output=True).returncode,0,0

print('ALL OK',ok)
